svg.text: Allwinner A20, Armbian with the mainline kernel. Pin 1 has the square solder pad.
= the pin can trigger interrupts (edge detection: wiringPiISR, GPIO.add_event_detect, gpiomon, lgpio alerts).
kernel GPIO = bank * 32 + pin (PA = 0, PB = 1 ... PI = 8), the number for libgpiod and lgpio (gpiochip0) and /sys/class/gpio. wPi / BCM = numbering of WiringBP and LMK.GPIO.

Default in Armbian: pins taken by drivers in the stock device tree; they still work as GPIO after the driver is disabled. Other functions: enable with an Armbian overlay (overlays= in /boot/armbianEnv.txt).
Pin 40 (PB8) switches the 5 V supply of the SATA disk: do not use it as GPIO. Pins 27/28 carry the touchscreen of the LeMaker LCD panels (I2C3) when a lemaker-lcd overlay is on.
All signal pins are 3.3 V, never connect 5 V to them.
